<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="ניסן_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918160_theRebbe_102" batchId="meluket-_D7_A0_D7_99_D7_A1_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918160_theRebbe_102__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the advantage of the soul's service while clothed in the body over its service above is that it reveals the intensity of its connection to G-d, even through concealment, and especially through a love beyond reason like a son's love for his father, revealing the soul's root in the Awtsmoos of Ein Sof.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="2">that the advantage of the service of the soul while it is clothed in the body over the service of the soul above before it descended below,</t>
    <t s="3">[is explained in] two general explanations.</t>
    <t s="4">That through [the fact]</t>
    <t s="5">that the soul serves G-d even while clothed in a physical body, the intensity of its connection with the Holy One, blessed be He, is revealed—</t>
    <t s="6">that the concealment and hiding of the body and the animal soul cannot nullify, G-d forbid, nor even diminish its connection.</t>
    <t s="7">And all the more so,</t>
    <t s="8">when the soul's service below is with a great love that is above reason and intellect,</t>
    <t s="9">like the love of a son for his father,</t>
    <t s="10">through which the intensity of its connection with the Holy One, blessed be He, is revealed, as it is from the essence of the soul as it is rooted in the Awtsmoos of Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="11">in the manner of a son as he is in the brain of the father himself.</t>
    <t s="12">For regarding the level of the soul as it is in Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="13">which is analogous to a son</t>
    <t s="14">(like)</t>
    <t s="15">that is drawn from the brain of the father,</t>
    <t s="16">the descent to Biyah</t>
    <t s="17">(and all the more so the descent below into this physical world)</t>
    <t s="18">conceals and hides this</t>
    <t s="19">[As is known,</t>
    <t s="20">that only souls of Atzilus are called by the name "sons"],</t>
    <t s="21">And that even in its descent below it is in the aspect of a son in revelation,</t>
    <t s="22">that its love is an essential love above reason and intellect, like the love of a son for his father,</t>
    <t s="23">is through the revelation of the essence of the soul as it is in the brain of the father</t>
    <t s="24">(before it was drawn forth),</t>
    <t s="25">for regarding this level</t>
    <t s="26">(the essence of the soul as it is rooted in the Awtsmoos),</t>
    <t s="27">Atzilus and Biyah are equal.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the primary revelation of the soul's essence rooted in the Awtsmoos comes through the work of refining the body and animal soul, because the Awtsmoos of Ein Sof is everywhere and undefined, enabling even the body to become a vessel for G-dliness.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And to add,</t>
    <t s="1">that the primary revelation of this level</t>
    <t s="2">(the essence of the soul as it is rooted in the Awtsmoos)</t>
    <t s="3">is through the service of refining and purifying the body, the animal soul, and one's portion in the world.</t>
    <t s="4">For that the body and animal soul cannot conceal the love of the soul that is above reason and intellect is because the Awtsmoos of Ein Sof</t>
    <t s="5">(in which the soul is rooted)</t>
    <t s="6">is in every place</t>
    <t s="7">(and therefore it is not possible that there be something that can conceal it),</t>
    <t s="8">and the power of the soul to refine and purify the body and animal soul themselves and make them into vessels for G-dliness is because the Awtsmoos of Ein Sof</t>
    <t s="9">(in which the soul is rooted)</t>
    <t s="10">is not defined by any definition,</t>
    <t s="11">therefore,</t>
    <t s="12">even the body and animal soul that, from the perspective of their nature</t>
    <t s="13">(from the perspective of their definition)</t>
    <t s="14">are not vessels for G-dliness,</t>
    <t s="15">behold, through the revelation of the power of the Awtsmoos,</t>
    <t s="16">they become vessels for G-dliness.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="14">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains a second explanation of the advantage of the soul's service in the body: the root of the body is higher than the root of the soul, because G-d's choice of the body stems from His essential free will, which is from His very Awtsmoos, and through the soul's service this aspect is drawn into the soul.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And another explanation of the advantage of the service of the soul while it is clothed in the body,</t>
    <t s="2">that the root of the body is higher than the root of the soul.</t>
    <t s="3">For regarding souls it is written,</t>
    <t s="4">"You are children to Hashem your G-d,"</t>
    <t s="5">and therefore,</t>
    <t s="6">the love and connection of the Holy One, blessed be He, to Israel from the perspective of their soul is in the manner of a father's love for his son,</t>
    <t s="7">that is,</t>
    <t s="8">that the root of this love is from a level where there is a place for the concept of the beloved,</t>
    <t s="9">and it is not from His very Essence.</t>
    <t s="10">But the love and connection of the Holy One, blessed be He, to Israel from the perspective of their body,</t>
    <t s="11">is</t>
    <t s="12">(not from the virtue of the body,</t>
    <t s="13">nor even the virtue of "son,"</t>
    <t s="14">[which is] an essential virtue,</t>
    <t s="15">but rather)</t>
    <t s="16">from the fact that the Holy One, blessed be He, chose the body of Israel,</t>
    <t s="17">with His free choice,</t>
    <t s="18">and this choice is from His very Essence.</t>
    <t s="19">And through the service of the soul in the body,</t>
    <t s="20">the aspect of the choice of the Essence is drawn also into the soul.</t>
    <t s="21">And that is,</t>
    <t s="22">that according to the first explanation,</t>
    <t s="23">the ascent that occurs in the soul through its service in the body is the revelation of its root in the Awtsmoos of Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="24">in the manner of a son as he is in the brain of the father himself</t>
    <t s="25">(before it was drawn forth),</t>
    <t s="26">and according to the second explanation,</t>
    <t s="27">through the service of the soul in the body, a new aspect is made in it—the drawing forth of the Awtsmoos</t>
    <t s="28">(which is above even the root of the soul as it is in the brain of the father himself).</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
